caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bird sculpture mounted on a rectangular base. The bird has a predominantly red body with brown wings and tail. Its head is black with a small beige area on the face, which is decorated with black spots. The beak is short and yellowish-brown. The bird is supported by two thin, dark rods that connect to the base. The base itself is rectangular, appearing to be made of a dark, possibly varnished wood or metal. The background is plain and untextured, filled with a solid light beige color.
title: Carved Wood Robin
